## Documentation

An inline keyboard that appears right next to the message it belongs to.

### Parameters

- **`inline_keyboard`** (List of List of [`InlineKeyboardButton`](InlineKeyboardButton.md) | [`InlineKeyboardButtonBuy`](InlineKeyboardButtonBuy.md))
  List of button rows, each represented by a List of InlineKeyboardButton objects.
  [`InlineKeyboardButtonBuy`](InlineKeyboardButtonBuy.md) objects is only for [`send_invoice`](../../methods/payments/send_invoice.md).
  and only one needed in the first row.

- **`force_reply`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if a reply to the message must be forced when the message is received.
